start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:turn-a-source-into-steps with the reader tool:read-a-web-page on https://example.com/guide."
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:turn-a-source-into-steps", with reader; it starts it with tool:run-workflow-definition (row workflow:turn-a-source-into-steps).
2. Read source: done when The submitted manifest contains all source pieces and the reader completeness readback.
3. Derive steps: done when Each piece has candidate canonical steps or an explicit source-pinned no_check reason.
4. Place steps: done when Every candidate step names an existing or explicitly proposed branch and an order.
5. Judge derivation: done when Every piece has a justified verdict and every derived step passes structural and semantic review.
6. Write and read back: done when Every submitted row exists at its exact target and its readback matches the checked content.
7. Measure coverage: done when coverage.ok is true and its source-piece counts match the complete source inventory; no unresolved gaps remain.
8. Read what it gives back: what step measure-coverage hands back

worked_examples.title: The whole source is read before any step is written
worked_examples.ask: Turn this guide at https://example.com/guide into steps.
worked_examples.given: The reader returned one source with 12 pieces and its completeness readback.

no_lists_because: Its steps answer in the run and keep their manifest in the run itself; it writes no list rows.
